title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: per-sailing and per-booking limits by category
content:
## What this card covers
This card lists, for every acceptance category of the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, three parameters used when acceptances are combined: the most containers of the category one customer may have accepted or pending on one sailing, the most live acceptances a booking may hold while one of this category is among them, and whether the booking may also carry a dangerous-goods acceptance of a different category.

## Parameters by category
| Category | Containers of the category per customer per sailing, at most | Live acceptances per booking, at most | Booking may also carry a different category |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 20 | 5 | Yes |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 15 | 3 | Yes |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 10 | 3 | Yes |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 6 | 1 | No |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 6 | 1 | No |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 2 | 1 | No |

## Reading the columns
- The sailing figure is counted in containers, per customer, for the category concerned.
- The booking figure is counted in acceptances and applies while an acceptance of the category is among the live acceptances on the booking.
- "No" in the last column marks the three categories that may not share a booking with an acceptance of another category.

## Basis Q&A
- *Which categories have a per-booking figure of 1?* AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers, AHL DG Compressed Gases and AHL DG Special Approval — the same three that show "No" in the last column.
- *What is the largest per-booking figure?* 5, for AHL DG Limited Quantity.
